stories.title: Hybrid quantum computers could finally get to grips with light and matter
stories.desc: Many of nature's most important processes depend on how particles of matter interact with light and other force-carrying particles. So far, however, it has proven difficult for conventional computers to determine how individual particles behave in these interactions.

stories.title: Gravity and quantum information linked through a derivation of Einstein's equations
stories.desc: Recent research shows that gravity and quantum information are deeply connected and that the shape of spacetime can be traced back to the way information is stored in quantum fields.

stories.title: One step closer to quantum computers that can correct their own mistakes
stories.desc: Researchers from Rutgers, IBM and collaborating institutions have shown that a quantum computer can check what is happening inside it and respond while it is running, repeatedly resetting parts of the system to bring chaotic behavior under control.
